name: Solm Hargrin
summary: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Solm Hargrin teaches rogues the quiet arts. The dwarf trains young dwarves and gnomes, and holds that honor among thieves matters as tensions rise across Azeroth.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Shadows
sections.body: Solm Hargrin trains rogues at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He welcomes young dwarves and gnomes, deciphers coded messages for them, and teaches techniques such as Eviscerate. Ironforge relies on mountaineers and warriors, but Solm knows some threats call for quieter methods. He teaches loyalty and honor among thieves as the world grows more unsettled.

faq.answer: Solm Hargrin trains rogues at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He teaches young dwarves and gnomes stealth and bladecraft.

faq.q: What is Solm Hargrin's philosophy on rogue work?
faq.answer: Solm teaches honor among thieves. He holds that loyalty to the craft and to one another matters, even when their methods are underhanded.

faq.q: What quests does Solm Hargrin provide or receive?
faq.answer: Novice dwarven rogues bring him an Encrypted Rune, while new gnomish rogues bring an Encrypted Memorandum. After deciphering these orders, Solm sends trainees to master offensive maneuvers in the field.

faq.q: Does Solm Hargrin train races other than dwarves?
faq.answer: Yes. Solm trains gnomes alongside dwarves in Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: As a dwarf or gnome beginning rogue training, you can learn the basics from Solm Hargrin, who also deciphers your first guild orders.
As a dwarf, you can follow a quieter path in Dun Morogh, where stealth and cunning have their place alongside armor and axes.
